# Safe Mark Doc

> Free, open source web app that adds tamper-resistant watermarks to sensitive documents (ID cards, passports, contracts, invoices) before sharing them. Everything runs in the browser: there is no server, no upload and no tracking, and it works offline once installed.

A watermark states who a copy is for, when it was made and what it may be used for, which makes the copy far less useful for identity fraud. Main features:

- Images (JPG, PNG, WebP…) and PDFs, including password-protected and multi-page PDFs.
- Watermark text with presets (identity check, rental, bank, job), an optional date in several formats and an optional trace code per copy, recorded in a local log to trace a leaked copy back to its recipient.
- Hard-to-remove patterns: wavy text, guilloché-style mesh and microtext.
- Redaction of sensitive areas: cover, blur or pixelate.
- Flattened output without metadata, exported to PDF, JPG or PNG, or shared with the system share sheet.
- Installable Progressive Web App in English and Spanish, with light and dark themes.

## App

- [Safe Mark Doc](https://kijart.github.io/safe-mark-doc/): the app, in the browser's language ([English](https://kijart.github.io/safe-mark-doc/?lang=en), [Spanish](https://kijart.github.io/safe-mark-doc/?lang=es))
